download_wizard_of_wikipedia_knowledge_r: download the Wizard of Wikipedia knowledge retriever model and all related models to a datapath
download_generator_and_retrieval_models: download the end2end generator and full dialogue retrieval models as dependencies for the knowledge retriever
download_models_from_parlai_zoo: download pretrained models from the Parlai zoo using the download_models utility with a specified version
review_download_function: review the download function that orchestrates downloading all Wizard of Wikipedia models including the knowledge retriever
summarize_knowledge_retriever_module: summarize the knowledge retriever module that provides pretrained retrieval models for the Wizard of Wikipedia dialogue task
